2123205348760981710.en_summary: Elon says $TSLA will introduce a fully autonomous version of the Model Y with no steering wheel or pedals: "It's going to make sense for us to make cars that can seat different amounts of people. We still need autonomous vehicles if you've got 4 or 6, or a whole family. What we plan to do is have an autonomous version of the Model Y that won't have steering wheels or pedals and would be good for transporting groups of 6 or 7 people." (via NYT Dealbook Summit today)
2123205348760981710.zh_summary: Elon表示TSLA將推出無方向盤或踏板的全自動Model Y版本：「為我們製造可容納不同人數的汽車是有意義的。如果你有4人或6人，或整個家庭，我們仍需要自動駕駛車輛。我們計劃做的是推出無方向盤或踏板的自動Model Y版本，適合運送6或7人群體。」（今日NYT Dealbook Summit）
